method: Primary pages opened and relevant text inspected through web; summaries paraphrase their applicable scope.

sources.supports: KV defaults to linearizable semantics; serializable reads may lag. Watches provide revision ordering but have no linearizability or bounded delivery delay. An uncertain response does not establish rollback.
A watch start revision is inclusive. Compacted histories cancel the watch with compact_revision; an application RESET must obtain a new consistent snapshot rather than invent a cursor.

Long-poll notifications prompt a separate configuration fetch. Apollo also documents periodic polling with a configurable five-minute default and a local file cache; these are not a ten-second fault-recovery guarantee.
Orca schedules at iteration granularity and uses selective batching. This supports the scheduling concept, not this chapter's numerical capacity.
PagedAttention separates logical KV access from physical placement and supports sharing. A memory layout result does not establish the chapter's goodput or cancellation protocol.
DistServe separates prefill and decode and considers goodput under TTFT/TPOT constraints plus transfer bandwidth. The paper's evaluated success fraction is not this site's p99 objective.

Pinned V1 documentation describes recomputation preemption, chunked prefill and decode-prioritized token budgeting, including ITL/TTFT tradeoffs. The teaching policy is not claimed as an engine default.
Prefix-cache identity includes tokens, parent hash and additional identities; cache_salt controls sharing domains. Active references, cached blocks and eviction are distinct accounting concepts.

CUDA Runtime 13.4 describes cudaErrorNotReady for incomplete asynchronous work, and illegal-address/launch-timeout errors requiring process restart. A local Java model does not validate actual device fences.
RRF combines reciprocal ranks starting at one, with absent documents contributing no term. rank_constant defaults to 60 in the documented implementation; shortlist sizes are teaching assumptions.

The pinned 0.8.0 README describes filtering after approximate index scans and iterative scans until enough candidates or a configured limit. A WHERE clause alone does not prove sufficient filtered recall.
The string-based security-filter pattern is not authentication or authorization. Trusted identity construction and authoritative rechecks remain application responsibilities.
ALCE separately evaluates correctness and citation quality. A valid evidence identifier alone does not prove that a sentence is supported; no claim of perfect automatic judgment is warranted.
